summary: [standards] Cutover leftovers: ObjectArtifacts::list_sized (canon-gate) has no caller after prune moved to list_objects, and ObjectBlobStore::list_sized is reached only by a unit test. The brief is a clean cutover; both could go. Also a deviation from brief F7 (canon-gate/others do not depend on zstd; Cargo.lock grows one canon-store line): canon-cli got a zstd dev-dependency, so Cargo.lock grew two lines. Dev-only, no new crate, the tests use it to decode frames independently of canon-store; harmless, noted because the brief spelled the lock diff.
